sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items:
Fixed `user-edits`/`user-open-edits` cramming the entire action-button toolbar, row-count badge, CAA toggle, and filter bar onto the same native heading (see `debug/user-edits-wrong.org`). Both pages render no native `

` at all — their only heading is a `

Edits by

` / `

Open edits by

` — so the page-load button-toolbar injection and the post-render filter/count/CAA-toggle injection both resolved to that one element, which then also got made collapsible (every `

` is fair game for `makeH2sCollapsible()`, unlike an `

` page title). Added a new `renameH2ToH1: true` feature (mirroring the existing `renameH2ToH3: true` used by tag pages) that promotes the native `

` to `

` — carrying the already-injected button toolbar with it, since the promotion moves child nodes rather than discarding them — and gave both page types `insertH2: 'Edits'` / `insertH2: 'Open edits'` so a fresh, dedicated `

` gets injected as the actual filter/count/CAA-toggle anchor, matching every other single-table page type's h1-title/h2-anchor split. New `applyRenameH2ToH1()` (mirrors `applyRenameH2ToH3()`) excludes any `

` nested inside a `div.edit-list` block — every real edit on an as-yet-unconverted edits-listing page carries its own native `

Edit #NNNNNN - Action

` heading, and promoting those too (confirmed via a jsdom run against the real `debug/edits-by-vzell.html` snapshot: 51 `

`s instead of 1, before this exclusion was added) would have been a much worse regression than the one being fixed. Verified via jsdom against both real snapshots: exactly one `

` and one `

` result, in the correct order, before `applyEditsToTable` removes the `div.edit-list` blocks.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Added two new page types for a user's own edit-listing pages: `user-edits` (`/user/<username>/edits`) and `user-open-edits` (`/user/<username>/edits/open`) — e.g. `/user/vzell/edits`, `/user/vzell/edits/open`. Both reuse the exact same `editsToTable`/`unboundedPagination`/`collapsableColumns`/`addCAA` pipeline as the existing `edits` page type (see `WIP.5` for the `renameH2ToH1`/`insertH2` heading setup these two needed on top of that, which the base `edits` page type does not). Also extended the `@include` header's `/user/<username>/...` regex to cover `edits`/`edits/open`, which it did not match before.

Fixed the two new page types failing to initialize at all ("Required elements not found. Terminating.", `hasHeader: false`) — confirmed live on `/user/vzell/edits`. Both pages render no `<h1>` whatsoever (only the native `<h2>` mentioned above), but every branch of the init header-detection chain required an `<h1>`, so `headerContainer` stayed `null` and the script aborted before doing anything. Added a `headerContainer` fallback scoped specifically to `user-edits`/`user-open-edits` (not a blanket "no h1 → use any h2" rule, to avoid masking a real missing-header case on some other page type) that falls back to the page's `<h2>` when no `<h1>` is found. Every other consumer of `headerContainer` already degrades gracefully to "use headerContainer itself" when no ancestor `<h1>` exists, so no other code needed to change.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fixed the `edits` page type's column filter highlighting matches in the wrong column — e.g. filtering the "Edit notes" column highlighted "alias" inside "Edit details" instead, or (with a trailing comma in the filter string) narrowed to the correct row but highlighted nothing at all. `highlightText()` was scanning `row.querySelectorAll('td')` and using its flat, recursive index to find the target column's cell, but that numbering doesn't match `row.cells`-based indexing (used by `testRowMatch()`/`getColFilters`) once any earlier cell contains nested real `<td>`/`<th>` elements — which every `_detableify()`'d "Edit details" cell does (per its own JSDoc, `<td>`/`<th>` are deliberately kept real for `rowspan`/`colspan`). `highlightText()` now resolves the target column via `row.cells[targetColIndex]` directly (matching the same numbering the match logic already uses) and lets `highlightCrossTag()` walk that cell's own subtree, which still finds nested matches correctly. The global-filter case (no target column) is unchanged. Row matching itself was already correct — only the highlight placement was wrong. See `debug/filter-bug.org`, `debug/editNotes-filter-bug.html`.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Reordered the `edits` page type's columns to group related content together: `Edit#`, `Edit action`, `Edit details`, `Edit notes`, `Entered from release`, `By artist`, `Edit by`, `My vote`, `Vote count`, `Closed/Approved`, `Voting`, `Edit status` (was: `Edit#`, `Edit action`, `Edit by`, `My vote`, `Vote count`, `Closed/Approved`, `Voting`, `Edit status`, `Entered from release`, `By artist`, `Edit details`, `Edit notes` — see `WIP.1`). `_buildEditRow()`'s cell-building order was moved to match, since cells are appended positionally against the `headers` array; no other code references these columns by index (`collapsableColumns`, `addCAA`, and the prose-column checks all key off the column name), so nothing else needed to change.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Added a new `edits` page type covering MusicBrainz edit-listing pages (`/search/edits`, `/<entity>/<mbid>/edits`, `/edit/subscribed`, `/edit/subscribed_editors`) — including the required `@include` header directives for all five URL shapes. Each `<div class="edit-list">` block is converted into a table row with 12 columns (Edit#, Edit action, Edit by, My vote, Vote count, Closed/Approved, Voting, Edit status, Entered from release, By artist, Edit details, Edit notes) via a new `applyEditsToTable()` DOM pre-processing step, mirroring `applyListToTable()`'s pattern. `Edit details` and `Edit notes` are collapsable/height-clamped the same way the Annotation column is — with a manual "more/less" toggle per cell plus a column-header "collapse all"/"expand all" button always available — but via independent `sa_edits_enable_details_collapse`/`sa_edits_enable_notes_collapse` settings controlling only the *initial* expand state: both default to off, so cells start expanded (unlike Annotation's default-on `sa_enable_annotation_collapse`, which starts collapsed); a fresh `Edits` `<h2>` filterline is injected so the single-table collapsible-section/filter-bar infrastructure has something to anchor to. `Entered from release`/`By artist` are populated by scanning for the entity-linked-to-artist-credit shape wherever it appears (not just the dedicated `.entered-from` block), so they cover far more edit types than just relationship edits (e.g. "Edit recording", "Edit medium", "Add cover art", ...), and get inline CAA cover-art thumbnails via `features.addCAA`. `Closed/Approved` covers both MusicBrainz's `Closed:` and `Approved:` `.edit-expiration` prefixes (the latter used for auto-editor edits that passed voting without ever being formally "closed").

Handled MusicBrainz's edit-listing pagination not always exposing a true last page. Small result sets either have no pagination at all or a complete, gap-free widget that already reveals the real last page (both handled correctly by the existing DOM-based detection); only the double-ellipsis milestone-window widget MusicBrainz shows for large/uncounted result sets ("Found at least N edits", confirmed live to keep growing past page 1000) is actually ambiguous. A new `_hasAmbiguousEditsPagination()` check now decides dynamically, per page, whether to trust the normal detection or fall back to a safety-capped fetch-until-empty-page strategy (`features.unboundedPagination`, `sa_max_page` setting) — scoped entirely to `editsToTable` pages, no behavior change for any other page type.

Colored the "Edit#" and "Edit action" columns by edit category (Add/Edit/Remove/Merge/Other) and open-vs-closed state, matching the well-known "MusicBrainz: Colourful edits" userscript's classification — but computed independently from `.edit-header`'s own class list rather than reading any inline/computed style (MusicBrainz sets no inline background there itself; visible color on a live page comes from its own class-based site CSS and/or that userscript if installed, neither of which is reliably readable from a detached, stylesheet-less fetched page). New `_editActionBgColor()` plus 11 configurable `sa_edits_color_*` color-picker settings (`🎨 EDITS PAGE COLORS` section, `sa_enable_edits_type_colors` master toggle) defaulting to that userscript's palette. `applyStickyColumn` learned a generic `data-mb-custom-cell-bg` per-cell marker — respected in both its sticky-cell and non-sticky-cell background computation — so a colored cell survives its zebra-striping-preserving cleanup pass without the function needing to know anything about the `edits` page type.

Colored old/new value diff cells inside the "Edit details" column's compare tables (e.g. a track-title edit's before/after row), matching MusicBrainz's own site CSS (`table.details td.new`/`td.old`) — which no longer matches anything once `.edit-details` has been de-tableified, since it requires a real `<table>` ancestor. `_ensureDetableifyStyle()` now also injects `!important` `.mb-dt-table td.new`/`.mb-dt-table td.old` rules (needed to reliably beat MusicBrainz's own zebra-striping CSS, which reaches these deeply-nested cells too on "even" rows) using the `.mb-dt-table` marker class `_detableify()` already stamps on the converted element. Configurable via `sa_enable_edits_diff_colors` (default on) / `sa_edits_color_diff_new` (`#e4fbe4`) / `sa_edits_color_diff_old` (`#fbe3e4`), defaults copied directly from MusicBrainz's own stylesheet.

Added zebra striping to nested compare tables inside "Edit details" (e.g. a medium edit's Old/New tracklist grid) — the `odd`/`even` classes survive `_detableify()`'s conversion untouched, but nothing colored them since MusicBrainz's own zebra CSS can't reach de-tableified content either. New `.mb-dt-tr.odd`/`.mb-dt-tr.even` rules in `_ensureDetableifyStyle()` set the background on both the row and its direct `.mb-dt-cell` children (not the row alone, which relies on painting through cells with no background of their own and silently fails to show on "even"/grey rows the moment anything sets a competing background directly on the cell) — matching how MusicBrainz's own equivalent rule always colors cells directly. Configurable via `sa_edits_color_zebra_odd` (`#ffffff`) / `sa_edits_color_zebra_even` (`#f2f2f2`).

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fixed `applyInsertH2` failing to insert (or mis-placing) its page-level filterline heading whenever native content it runs before-processing (e.g. a wiki-formatted edit note, which can contain its own `== Edits ==` sub-heading and/or a native `<h3 class="owner">`) happened to collide with the chosen label or heading level. The idempotency guard now stamps and checks a `data-mb-injected-h2` marker instead of matching by text content (position/timing-independent, can't be fooled by unrelated headings); the "before first h3" placement fallback now also excludes headings nested inside `div.edit-list`, alongside the existing `table.tbl` exclusion. General fix to shared insertH2 infrastructure, not specific to the `edits` page type.

Fixed `rowspan`/`colspan` being silently dropped from `.edit-details` compare tables (a relationship diff's old/new values rendering side-by-side instead of stacked; a medium edit's "Old tracklist"/"New tracklist" 4-column group headers collapsing to one column each). `_detableify()` was converting `<th>`/`<td>` into `<div>`s, but `rowSpan`/`colSpan` are DOM properties only real table-cell elements expose. `<th>`/`<td>` are now left as real elements (only `<table>`/`<thead>`/`<tbody>`/`<tfoot>`/`<tr>` are converted, which is all the nested-table-corruption fix ever needed).

Fixed the "By artist" column including trailing relationship-attribute description text after the artist credit (e.g. "... has a discography entry at <url> [info]", "... can be purchased for download at <url> [info]"). `_splitEnteredFrom` now stops right after the first element following "by" (the artist-credit `<bdi>`) instead of taking the rest of the sentence.

Fixed "Edit details"/"Edit notes" having no way to manually collapse a cell (or the whole column) at all once uncollapsed-by-default landed — the earlier implementation gated off the entire clamp/toggle mechanism when the new setting was false, not just the initial visual state. The mechanism now always stays active; the setting only controls whether cells start expanded (the default) or collapsed, via a one-time `expandedCells` pre-population on the first render after a fetch that a later manual collapse correctly survives across sort/filter re-renders.

Fixed the global "collapse all"/"expand all" button and the per-column header collapse toggle both staying stuck on "Expand all" (`aria-expanded="false"`) even when a column's cells had actually started expanded — both were unconditionally hardcoded to the collapsed initial state in `initCollapsableColumns`. They now track whether any cell in the relevant column(s) started expanded and reflect that in their initial glyph/`aria-expanded`/title, same as an individual cell's own toggle already did.

Fixed `sa_ui_row_hover_bg` (the table row hover background color, used by `applyStickyColumn` for every table this script renders, not just edits) having no `configSchema` entry at all despite being read in code — it was permanently stuck on its `#e2e2e2` JS-side fallback and never actually adjustable via the settings menu. Also added a CSS `tr:hover .mb-dt-table .mb-dt-cell` rule using this setting: the existing JS-driven hover handler only ever touches a row's direct `<td>` children, so it never reached deeply-nested cells inside de-tableified "Edit details" content, which MusicBrainz's own native hover CSS was darkening instead (reaching arbitrary depth, same pattern as its zebra rule) — making their thin `#ddd` borders nearly invisible.
